programs.name: conjtest
programs.purpose: Solve a fixed five-equation system and print the matrix, input vector, and calculated solution.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: compute solution for x in Ax=b using conjugate gradients
programs.float_sensitive_notes: The solver performs ten conjugate-gradient iterations using float matrix products, sequential dot-product accumulations, divisions, and a small determinant adjustment. Rounding, contraction, and evaluation precision can affect the printed result.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program depends on an iterative conjugate-gradient solver whose floating-point behavior must be reproduced.

test_cases.description: Confirm the program does not consume standard input.

programs.name: ctrlstrip
programs.purpose: Copy printable input characters, tabs, and newlines while discarding other characters.
programs.float_sensitive_notes: Character classification depends on the active C locale.
programs.difficulty_reason: It filters input one character at a time using the C character-classification function.

test_cases.description: Keep printable text, tabs, and newlines while stripping control characters.

programs.license_note: Credits the Masscomp RTU Programming Manual.

programs.name: downfort
programs.purpose: Convert Fortran source to lowercase while preserving comment lines and most quoted strings.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: DOWNFORT - change Fortran programs to lower case, preserving strings
programs.float_sensitive_notes: Character classification and case conversion depend on the active C locale. Inner loops do not check EOF, so an unterminated line or quoted string can loop indefinitely.
programs.difficulty_reason: It transforms source text with simple line and quote handling.

test_cases.description: Convert code while preserving a comment and a quoted string.
Exercise the special quoted-parenthesis case and a blank line.

programs.name: fcat
programs.purpose: Concatenate named files to standard output using one read and one write per file.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: FCAT - fast cat with 1 read per file
programs.float_sensitive_notes: The file size is converted to int before the 8 MiB limit check; a failed open is followed by fstat on an invalid descriptor and use of an uninitialized stat structure. Short reads or writes fail instead of being retried.
programs.difficulty_reason: It reads and writes each named file with a fixed-size buffer.

test_cases.command: sunull nt=8 ntr=2 > in1.su && sunull nt=16 ntr=1 > in2.su && fcat in1.su in2.su
sunull nt=8 ntr=1 > in.su && fcat in.su

programs.name: isatty
programs.purpose: Report whether a supplied file descriptor refers to a terminal.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: ISATTY - pass on return from isatty(2)
programs.float_sensitive_notes: The reported value depends on whether the supplied descriptor is attached to a terminal.
programs.difficulty_reason: It parses one positional argument and reports the result of a system call.

test_cases.description: Check standard input when connected to a pipe.

programs.name: maxints
programs.purpose: Calculate and print minimum and maximum values for several C integer types.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: MAXINTS - Compute maximum and minimum sizes for integer types
programs.float_sensitive_notes: The signed left shifts overflow and have undefined behavior; the signed minimum expressions also overflow. Results and termination depend on integer widths, compiler, and optimization.
programs.difficulty_reason: It uses small integer loops and prints their results, although reproducing its undefined behavior is platform-dependent.
